# Sprint for AI agents

```text
Sprint CLI for AI agents

Install: npm install --global @hyungjuk/sprint
Check installation: sprint --version
Business calls require a configured Sprint server and authentication; npm login is unrelated.

Discovery
  sprint --help                       Command groups
  sprint issues --help                Immediate issue subcommands
  sprint issues get --help            Exact CLI syntax and examples
  sprint help -- subscription         Literal help search
  sprint --schema issues              API action contracts (JSON), not CLI flags
  sprint --llms issues                Existing domain contract JSON
  sprint topic authentication         Sessions and private token files
  sprint topic output                 JSON output, pagination and exit codes

Workflow
  Confirm the target server/project and user-requested scope.
  Check sprint whoami --non-interactive with an authorized profile or token file.
  Read exact subcommand help; never invent flags or IDs.
  Use --non-interactive; parse JSON stdout and nonzero exit codes.
  Bound queries with advertised --limit flags. Business commands already return JSON; no --format flag exists.
  Read current revisions before writes and verify responses. Never retry mutations blindly.
  Do not create or complete issues merely because a user asked a question.
  Missing authentication or permission must be reported, not treated as success.

Examples
  sprint issues get SPR-123 --non-interactive
  sprint issues list --project PROJECT_ID --limit 10 --non-interactive
  sprint mcp serve --profile default --domains issues,workTeams

Agent discovery
  Add Sprint usage rules to project instructions (e.g. AGENTS.md).
  Optionally register the existing stdio MCP server with your AI client.
  CLI installation alone does not register agent rules or an Agent Skill.
  No Sprint Agent Skill installer is currently provided.

Documentation: https://github.com/Hyungjuk42/sprint-docs
```

[Command index](README.md) · [Authentication](reference/topic/authentication.md) · [Output and exit codes](reference/topic/output.md)

To make an agent discover Sprint, add project instructions such as:

```markdown
Use Sprint CLI or Sprint MCP for this project's issue and sprint management.
The executable is sprint; the package is @hyungjuk/sprint.
Before using a command, read its exact --help.
Confirm the target project and current record before writes.
Use --non-interactive and verify JSON responses.
Do not create or complete issues for questions or read-only investigation alone.
```

A configured Sprint session or private automation-token file is required for business operations. An npm login is unrelated. No automatic Agent Skill installer is currently shipped.
